title: GT transfer and lazy-descent STNFS core (recover-Q 9332a74d + our levers): measured wide-prime, line and run-coset record kernels, fresh judged pool, excess 1.05, mean + 2 SE filtering: 122.832698714187363

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). It maps T to z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b (exactly the uniform nonidentity-base, independent-target distribution), converts both into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is recover-Q 9332a74d's with our v7/v8 levers and the changes of our plain P5-P8: theta=2326/8000 sized on pool B and judged once on a fresh pool D (retained relations >= 2^63.6016, 0.0798 bits above 1.05 U), measured wide-prime and line kernels; new here, primes in [2^52, 2^63) are walked once per canonical a-run (rec7) on runs of 32 to 1,024 a-values. Work on pools B, C, D with allowance 1.0047: collection <= 2^119.21522964 units; N <= 2^58.7868, Block Wiedemann (28, 5): linear algebra <= 2^116.981242966, generator <= 2^107.555167552; 62-node lazy descent, meter 2^113.104; rec7 bases 2^68.3; upper-rounded core ledger rows sum to at most 2^119.51077061924 <= 2^119.5107706193 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is at most 10 x 2^119.5107706193 + 2^80/2000 < 2^122.832698714187363 G1 reference units (C=2,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit. {}: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, integration probes, lazy bound vs a simulation, core ledger and success, G1 conversion (80-digit) and base-randomisation bijections. {"descent": true} also re-evaluates the descent recurrence, node counter and success. evidence16.py (local, about 4 minutes natively, not a hosted experiment) reruns every certificate and check.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py, purge target 0.0001) at relation excess 1.05 (default; optional 'excess') and the shipped means to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.87) and U/N. Optional. Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
